title: Integrate AuditLogger into POST path, AUTHINFO, and admin endpoint
description:
Call AuditLogger at: (1) every successful article signing in the POST path (ArticleSigned event), (2) every AUTHINFO USER/PASS attempt (AuthAttempt event, success and failure), (3) every admin HTTP request (AdminAccess event). Pass AuditLogger handle through session context. Artifact: integration in reader/src/session/commands/ and admin handlers.

Acceptance: all three event types appear in audit log after corresponding operations; failed auth is logged; successful auth is logged; admin access logged with status code
